items.author: yosoymario91
items.text:
I asked grok bot to summarize my setup: 

Penny is my accountant bot. She handles my taxes and finances. Poteto is my coder bot, and she built my personal finance dashboard. Closer handles my work email and that kind of thing.

They all send their daily summaries to Scribe, who writes everything into my Obsidian vault.

The dashboard runs pretty much on its own. Once a month I export my bank statement and give it to Penny, she logs everything into the dashboard, and I can see all my finances in one place. It also has my Google calendar connected so if theres anything coming up grok bot notices me.

They also generally check my emails and draft replies for me, and stuff like that.

zh-CN.title: 用多个 Grok Bot 分工管理财务、代码和邮件
zh-CN.summary: 作者的设置：Penny 负责税务和财务，Poteto 写代码并搭了个人财务看板，Closer 处理工作邮件，它们每天把总结交给 Scribe 写入 Obsidian 库。每月导出一次银行流水给 Penny 记账；看板连接了 Google 日历，有事临近时会提醒，也会查看邮件并起草回复。

zh-TW.title: 用多個 Grok Bot 分工管理財務、程式和郵件
zh-TW.summary: 作者的設定：Penny 負責稅務和財務，Poteto 寫程式並做了個人財務儀表板，Closer 處理工作郵件，它們每天把摘要交給 Scribe 寫入 Obsidian 庫。每月匯出一次銀行對帳單給 Penny 記帳；儀表板連接了 Google 日曆，有事將近時會提醒，也會查看郵件並草擬回覆。

en.title: Several Grok Bots split finances, code and email
en.summary: The author's setup: Penny handles taxes and finances, Poteto codes and built a personal finance dashboard, and Closer handles work email. All send daily summaries to Scribe, which writes them into an Obsidian vault. Once a month the bank statement goes to Penny, who logs it into the dashboard; Google Calendar is connected for reminders, and the bots draft email replies.

ja.title: 複数の Grok Bot で財務・コード・メールを分担
ja.summary: 投稿者の構成：Penny が税務と財務、Poteto がコーディングを担当し個人財務ダッシュボードを構築、Closer が仕事のメールを処理。全員が毎日の要約を Scribe に送り、Scribe が Obsidian の保管庫に書き込む。月に一度銀行明細を Penny に渡して記帳し、Google カレンダー連携で予定を知らせ、メールの返信下書きも行う。

ko.title: 여러 Grok Bot으로 재무·코딩·이메일 분담
ko.summary: 작성자의 구성: Penny는 세금과 재무, Poteto는 코딩을 맡아 개인 재무 대시보드를 만들었고, Closer는 업무 이메일을 처리한다. 모두 매일 요약을 Scribe에 보내고 Scribe가 Obsidian 보관소에 기록한다. 한 달에 한 번 은행 명세서를 Penny에게 주면 대시보드에 기록되고, Google 캘린더가 연결되어 일정을 알려주며 이메일 답장 초안도 작성한다.

ms.title: Beberapa Grok Bot membahagi kewangan, kod dan e-mel
ms.summary: Susunan penulis: Penny mengurus cukai dan kewangan, Poteto menulis kod dan membina papan pemuka kewangan peribadi, Closer mengurus e-mel kerja. Semua menghantar ringkasan harian kepada Scribe yang menulisnya ke dalam vault Obsidian. Sebulan sekali penyata bank diberi kepada Penny untuk direkod; Google Calendar disambung untuk peringatan, dan bot merangka balasan e-mel.

vi.title: Nhiều Grok Bot chia việc tài chính, code và email
vi.summary: Cách thiết lập của tác giả: Penny lo thuế và tài chính, Poteto viết code và dựng bảng điều khiển tài chính cá nhân, Closer xử lý email công việc. Tất cả gửi bản tóm tắt hằng ngày cho Scribe để ghi vào kho Obsidian. Mỗi tháng tác giả xuất sao kê ngân hàng cho Penny ghi sổ; Google Calendar được kết nối để nhắc việc, và các bot soạn nháp trả lời email.

fr.title: Plusieurs Grok Bots se partagent finances, code et e-mails
fr.summary: Configuration de l'auteur : Penny gère impôts et finances, Poteto code et a construit un tableau de bord financier personnel, Closer s'occupe des e-mails professionnels. Tous envoient un résumé quotidien à Scribe, qui l'écrit dans un coffre Obsidian. Chaque mois, le relevé bancaire est confié à Penny qui l'enregistre ; Google Agenda est connecté pour les rappels et les bots rédigent des brouillons de réponses.

es.title: Varios Grok Bots se reparten finanzas, código y correo
es.summary: La configuración del autor: Penny lleva impuestos y finanzas, Poteto programa y creó un panel de finanzas personales, y Closer gestiona el correo de trabajo. Todos envían resúmenes diarios a Scribe, que los escribe en una bóveda de Obsidian. Una vez al mes el extracto bancario va a Penny, que lo registra; Google Calendar está conectado para avisos y los bots redactan borradores de respuesta.

de.title: Mehrere Grok Bots teilen sich Finanzen, Code und E-Mail
de.summary: Das Setup des Autors: Penny kümmert sich um Steuern und Finanzen, Poteto programmiert und hat ein persönliches Finanz-Dashboard gebaut, Closer erledigt die Arbeits-E-Mails. Alle schicken tägliche Zusammenfassungen an Scribe, der sie in einen Obsidian-Vault schreibt. Einmal im Monat geht der Kontoauszug an Penny zur Erfassung; Google Kalender ist für Erinnerungen verbunden, und die Bots entwerfen E-Mail-Antworten.

items.author: MathisMigue
items.text:
Shiiiit!
My AI agents were supposed to take 90% of my work off my plate. So why am I still the last one in the office? 👀

In reality, Grok Bot saves me 1–2 hours a day. My agents help me in Brand research, finding Gigs, outreach, and put together offers. They also help with editor briefs, early ad concepts, image creation, and transcripts.

I’m still relatively new to marketing. Since moving from art direction into creative strategy/copywriting, I’ve been learning new things every day. And I don’t think that ever stops…

What I like about Grokbot is that I can onboard my agents like real team members. I give each one a name and a role on the team. I share examples, have them watch training videos, and give them feedback on their drafts. I even interview them, and they interview me too. I train them like real employees to run my business! 

Then I decide who gets hired and who gets fired :D

Some of my agents now write copy I can actually use in my ads. But if I blindly trust what they give me, I skip the part where I learn to judge the work for myself. And if I stop developing that judgment, I make myself a lot easier to replace with AI.

AI IS STILL A TOOL. I can onboard my agents like team members, but I’m still the one making the calls.

So I’m automating things bit by bit. I’m happy with every hour my agents save me, and I stay hands-on with the work that helps me grow as a creative strategist.

What have you already automated, and what do you still choose to do yourself?

Let me know in the comments 👇

Run Meal Concierge planning on ChatGPT Dots
## What changed

- Install and run store-free Meal Concierge on a ChatGPT Dot's own cloud computer. Foreground commands use the shared installer, household application and skill without a socket listener or native MCP registration.
- Preserve the original household and command receipts across turns and program updates. Historical receipts cannot reissue native send authority, and previously exported files are checked against their frozen digest.
- Extend the separate native MENY interface with host-attested catalog reads and general shopping-list access. The existing account, cart and recovery guards still apply.
- Document ordinary setup, pinned PR testing versus a published stable install, updates, attachments, scheduling and troubleshooting.

## Verified in ChatGPT Dots

The exact head `2fe6f8bbcc97a286d0ae3a75e60025d77cc63e74` updated the same private cloud household in place. Fresh installed tools and status reported this build. The revision-2 three-portion menu and pantry deduction reopened, as did a historical receipt and the hash-checked frozen PDF. A checkout request was refused before application startup. Nine foreground and two native adapter fixtures passed on this exact head.

Earlier commits in this PR exercised first install and repeat setup, recipe import, preferences, pantry, portions, menu edits, shopping lists and the optional collection round trip. The collection imported and removed 1,416 entries while the synthetic recipe and menu survived. The shared skill worked from its installed files. The native skill catalog did not show a registered entry.

A PDF and recipe cover were opened from the Dot conversation. The PDF's rendered contents matched; Library rewrote its bytes, so frozen-byte acceptance was not recorded. Two one-shot planning runs posted

fr.summary: Cette PR installe et exécute Meal Concierge sur l'ordinateur cloud propre à un ChatGPT Dot, conserve les données du foyer et les reçus de commandes entre les tours et les mises à jour, et documente l'installation, les mises à jour, la planification et le dépannage.
